causal_diagnosis.smallest_causal_boundary: Candidate-v12 ends after child exit by emitting a no-write terminal envelope. A separate outer multi-cell orchestrator must retain tool-session ID and poll count, reconstruct a completion-v2 record, then create and reopen receipt, completion, capture, score, and validation evidence. Run01 polled A02 to exit zero and preserved its valid receipt, but discarded the session metadata before completion construction. The frozen controller therefore did not own enough durable state to seal the started cell.

required_architecture.design_rule: One foreground cell-controller invocation owns admission through durable seal. It may call the already isolated subject-call primitive and unchanged semantic functions, but no outer caller constructs evidence, supplies completion facts, or performs cell persistence. The outer scheduler may only select the next predeclared row, invoke one cell transaction, consume its final status, and refuse advancement unless the durable completion seal independently reopens.
transaction_order: Read and verify frozen candidate manifest, run contract, exact ordered schedule row, route, cell, model/thinking request, and unique predeclared dispatch nonce.
Reject before start if any final evidence path, attempt record, reused nonce, prior receipt, prior thread/turn collision, or schedule mismatch exists.

Render with the unchanged semantic renderer; create the canonical rendered file with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, fsync file and parent, reopen, require regular non-link, exactly one terminal LF, stable identity, and exact equality to a second independent render before any subject start.

Create and fsync one immutable dispatch-attempt record before the subject call. It binds candidate, run, slot, cell, ordered index, nonce, semantic packet hash/bytes, first-attempt=true, retry=0, best_of=false, replacement=false. Presence of this record permanently forbids another call for the row, including after crash ambiguity.

Invoke the isolated subject-call primitive in the same foreground controller transaction and wait for actual child/task completion. Defer SIGINT and SIGTERM from the attempt record through final seal; SIGKILL or host loss leaves an unsealed attempt that is controller-invalid and never relaunched.

Validate receipt-v4 exactly, including candidate/run/slot/cell/root, render and semantic hashes, schedule and nonce binding, fresh_context=true, first_attempt=true, retry=0, best_of=false, replacement=false, one new thread_id and turn_id, exact requested route, rollout path/hash/bytes, and rollout proof of the same nonce, semantic packet, task, turn, model, and effort.

Create-only persist and fsync receipt-v4; derive and create-only persist capture-v3 through the unchanged capture validator; invoke the unchanged scorer once; create-only persist its canonical score; reopen and byte-validate render, attempt, receipt, capture, and score.

Construct completion-v3 in memory as the final commit record, binding the exact hashes/bytes of all prior members, child exit-zero/full-stdout facts owned by this process, score verdict, first-attempt facts, and material-validation PASS. Create-only persist and fsync completion-v3 last, then independently reopen the entire chain and emit FULL_CHAIN_SEALED_SAFE or a fail-closed invalid status.

Advance the schedule only after the final completion-v3 seal reopens and the independent verifier returns PASS. A semantic FAIL is a sealed first-attempt result and stops qualification; it is never retried or replaced.
